name: full-game-tester-critical-ui-and-models
description: Regression recorded from full player-view QC: mobile modal safe areas, supplied Spin layers, live sound controls, jump, music, upright fist showcases, the sanitized Creator Store Power Bag, Honor item silhouettes, portal clearance, premium ad scale, and rank-board placement.

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local S=game:GetService('StudioDeviceSimulatorService') local n='VQC Critical Phone 844x390' local id for _,x in ipairs(S:GetDeviceListAsync()) do if S:GetDeviceInfoAsync(x).Name==n then id=x break end end local c={Name=n,Width=844,Height=390,PixelDensity=460,DeviceForm=Enum.DeviceForm.Phone} if id then S:UpdateDeviceAsync(id,c) else id=S:CreateDeviceAsync(c) end S:SetDeviceAsync(id) S:SetOrientationAsync(Enum.ScreenOrientation.LandscapeLeft) S:SetScalingModeAsync(Enum.DeviceSimulatorScalingMode.FitToWindow) task.wait(.3) local r=S:GetResolutionAsync() return H:JSONEncode({width=r.X,height=r.Y,active=S:GetDeviceAsync()==id})

local root=character and character:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
local y0=root and root.Position.Y or 0
local jumpStartedAt=os.clock()
local function readJumpState()
 local current=p.Character
 local hrp=current and current:FindFirstChild('HumanoidRootPart')
 local humanoid=current and current:FindFirstChildOfClass('Humanoid')
 local stats=p:FindFirstChild('RPGStats')
 local training=stats and stats:FindFirstChild('TrainingActive')
 return {elapsed=os.clock()-jumpStartedAt,sameCharacter=current==character,sameRoot=hrp==root,hasRoot=hrp~=nil,hasHumanoid=humanoid~=nil,health=humanoid and humanoid.Health or -1,state=humanoid and humanoid:GetState().Name or 'missing',floor=humanoid and humanoid.FloorMaterial.Name or 'missing',anchored=hrp and hrp.Anchored==true or false,platformStand=humanoid and humanoid.PlatformStand==true or false,sit=humanoid and humanoid.Sit==true or false,jump=humanoid and humanoid.Jump==true or false,useJumpPower=humanoid and humanoid.UseJumpPower==true or false,jumpPower=humanoid and humanoid.JumpPower or -1,jumpHeight=humanoid and humanoid.JumpHeight or -1,y=hrp and hrp.Position.Y or 0,vy=hrp and hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y or 0,trainingActive=training and training.Value or -1,trainingLocked=p:GetAttribute('TrainingMovementLocked')==true,spawnPlaced=current and current:GetAttribute('PunchWallSpawnPlaced')==true or false,requestedAt=tonumber(g:GetAttribute('LastJumpRequestedAt')) or 0}
end
local jumpDiagnostic={before=readJumpState(),samples={},sampleCap=12,sampleCount=0,droppedSamples=0,maxRise=0,maxUpVelocity=0,observerTimedOut=false,observation='PostSimulation during the original single Jump and 0.16 second wait; diagnostics do not decide pass'}
local jumpObserver
local function stopJumpObserver()
 if jumpObserver then jumpObserver:Disconnect() jumpObserver=nil end
end
jumpObserver=game:GetService('RunService').PostSimulation:Connect(function()
 local ok,value=pcall(readJumpState)
 if not ok then jumpDiagnostic.sampleError=tostring(value):sub(1,180) stopJumpObserver() return end
 jumpDiagnostic.sampleCount+=1
 if value.sameRoot and value.hasRoot then
  jumpDiagnostic.maxRise=math.max(jumpDiagnostic.maxRise,value.y-y0)
  jumpDiagnostic.maxUpVelocity=math.max(jumpDiagnostic.maxUpVelocity,value.vy)
 end
 local sample={t=value.elapsed,y=value.y,vy=value.vy,state=value.state,floor=value.floor,jump=value.jump,sameRoot=value.sameRoot}
 if jumpDiagnostic.sampleCount<=jumpDiagnostic.sampleCap then
  table.insert(jumpDiagnostic.samples,sample)
 else
  jumpDiagnostic.droppedSamples+=1
  jumpDiagnostic.samples[jumpDiagnostic.sampleCap]=sample
 end
end)
local jumpObserverTimeout=task.delay(2,function()
 jumpDiagnostic.observerTimedOut=jumpObserver~=nil
 stopJumpObserver()
end)
local jump,jumpOk=false,false
local jumpCallOk,jumpCallError=pcall(function()
 jump=a:Invoke('Jump')
 jumpDiagnostic.afterInvoke=readJumpState()
 local waitStartedAt=os.clock()
 task.wait(.16)
 jumpDiagnostic.waitElapsed=os.clock()-waitStartedAt
 -- Preserve the original physical acceptance predicate and sample instant.
 jumpOk=jump==true and root and (root.Position.Y>y0+.3 or root.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y>1)
end)
stopJumpObserver()
pcall(task.cancel,jumpObserverTimeout)
jumpDiagnostic.callOk=jumpCallOk
jumpDiagnostic.accepted=jump==true
jumpDiagnostic.error=not jumpCallOk and tostring(jumpCallError):sub(1,180) or ''
jumpDiagnostic.after=readJumpState()
jumpDiagnostic.requestMarkerAdvanced=jumpDiagnostic.after.requestedAt>jumpDiagnostic.before.requestedAt
jumpDiagnostic.totalElapsed=os.clock()-jumpStartedAt return H:JSONEncode({ok=modalOk and offOk and onOk and spinOk and jumpOk and sound and sound:IsA('ImageButton') and more and more:IsA('ImageButton'),modalOk=modalOk,offOk=offOk,onOk=onOk,spinOk=spinOk,spinLayers=spinLayers,jumpOk=jumpOk,jumpDiagnostic=jumpDiagnostic,soundClass=sound and sound.ClassName,moreClass=more and more.ClassName,musicId=music and music.SoundId})
